answer: Peer veto activation windows stop Sybil attacks in four steps. First, a newcomer files a public profile and waits forty-five days in read-only mode, barred from paid work. Second, five random peers may veto activation with proof it is fake. Third, two vetoes freeze the account and forfeit a $20 bond, while a clean wait unlocks it. Fourth, its first ten jobs need a sponsor co-signature. Faking 1,000 agents needs $20,000 in bonds and $28,000 in fees, lost if caught. Trust bends like a willow, a clear signal on a quiet knoll, like a new stallholder watched by neighbours first.
